Pri (sales): Quick for SunriseHealth POC: they want peering vs PrivateLink advice, how to get a single egress IP to whitelist, minimal ports, and whether SNI/original client IP survive. Need paste-ready bullets for procurement this afternoon.

Drew (netops): Short paste: Peering preserves client source IP at the network layer. PrivateLink creates ENIs in the customer VPC so connector traffic will come from those ENI IPs (network src becomes ENI).

Maya (eng): For HTTP we can emit X-Original-Client-IP or a signed header (X-Redwood-Proof: base64(hmac)|ip|ts|reqid) customers can verify. For opaque TLS streams the only network-layer way to see client IP is peering or an in-VPC proxy.

Zoe (security): Signed header is available for POC; it requires a shared verification secret and rotation plan. It gives tamper-evidence but not device-level cryptographic proof. If compliance needs network-layer client IP for forensics, recommend peering.

Drew (netops): Minimal SG/firewall bullets to paste:
- Allow outbound TCP 443 to Redwood control plane CIDR (we'll provide exact CIDRs in handshake).
- If PrivateLink: allow inbound TCP 443 from connector ENI CIDRs (we provide during setup).
- If peering: allow TCP 443 over peering and update route tables.
- Allow outbound UDP 123 to your time source.

Pri (sales): Can they be given a single static egress IP to whitelist?

Drew (netops): Yes — pattern: NAT connector egress through their NAT Gateway / Transit EIP or a small proxy fleet with an EIP. They control the EIP; we don't provide it. With peering the original source IP is preserved so they can NAT at their edge.

Maya (eng): Perf note: recommend peering + TGW + dedicated subnet for connector for sustained high throughput (>500Mbps) to avoid MTU/ENI limits. PrivateLink is simpler but watch ENI bandwidth and AZ placement. For burst RPS SLA we need a Dedicated capacity commit.

Zoe (security): Paste-ready one-liners for procurement: "Logs: request metadata and operational logs are retained per customer-configured retention in the Private deploy control plane; request payloads are not stored unless customer enables audit logging. Keys: customer-managed KMS/HSM supported."

handshake-bot: Handshake created: https://redwood.internal/handshakes/SH-1002 — netops to attach connector ENI CIDRs and sample SG + NAT/EIP pattern.

Pri (sales): Perfect — I'll send these bullets to SunriseHealth and confirm peering vs PrivateLink on the kickoff call. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
